description: Estimate first-aid cover for each shift from HSE guidance: how many first-aiders or appointed persons, which course, whether the first-aiders already there are enough, and whether a first-aid room is worth having. Construction site by default; also factory, office, shop, nursery (EYFS) and school. Returns roles, training, shortages, practical steps, factors, source lineage and a calculator link with the same inputs. This starts a workplace needs assessment; it is not a statutory staffing quota.

factors.description: Relevant factor ids returned by this tool for the selected workplace.

firstAidersAvailable.description: First-aiders already available on each shift, in the same order.

receptionClass.description: For a school: whether it has a reception or nursery class.

shifts.description: Highest number of people present at once on each shift.

work.description: Workplace setting; defaults to construction site.

name: first_aid_requirements

limit.description: What the result does not establish.

source.description: ComplyOnSite page that shows the same answer.

summary.description: The answer in one to three plain sentences, the figure or code first.
